title: Psychedelic Strawberry Clock Illustration
coreRelationships: The central clock face acts as the focal point around which all text and patterns revolve.
Wavy horizontal color bands define the boundaries for the stacked typographic layers.
Floral and strawberry motifs in the corners balance the central mechanical subject.
High-contrast color pairings (orange/blue, red/green) create visual vibration.
reuseFormula: Combine [Art Nouveau curves] with [1960s psychedelic color palettes] and [liquid-warped display type] centered around a [surrealist object motif].
